charge_port.notes: Genesis USA: 2023-2025 Genesis EVs have CCS ports (NACS only from 2026).
Estimated: Genesis Canada said new or refreshed EVs get NACS only from 2025; the GV70 refresh is the 2026 model, so a 2025 Canadian car is assumed CCS1 like the US 2025 car. Not proven for Canada.

supercharger_access.notes: US: free Genesis NACS-to-CCS adapter for eligible owners (bought or leased by 2025-01-31); about 20,000 Supercharger sites.
Canada: Genesis announced Supercharger access via adapter for CCS Genesis EVs from Q1 2025 (names the Electrified GV70).
